item.title: CHOMP: Cope comes home to take over budding West Fork athletic program
item.description: New Caney West Fork has found its new leader, hiring Brian Cope as the program’s athletic coordinator and head football coach. Cope arrives after a successful stint at Lake Belton High School, where he established himself as an energetic, culture-driven program builder.VYPE’s Matt Malatesta caught up with the newly hired head coach to talk about his return to the Greater Houston area, the high-energy culture he brings with him, and the mentors who have shaped his coaching journey along the way.

item.title: ON MY WHISTLE: The Realignment Recap
item.description: The UIL Realignment took center stage this week, putting the entire state of Texas on notice. High schools from every corner of the state learned their fate — who they’ll battle, where they’ll travel, and what the next few years will look like on the field and beyond. There’s no shortage of storylines coming out of the shakeup, and VYPE’s Matt Malatesta and Jackson DiPasquale break down every district, every move, and the impact it will have across the state.
